_comment: The body catalogue. Every entry is three fields the seed prompt joins onto the shared figurine grammar in bobble.py: subject, costume, pose. Nothing here says 'no cast shadow' or 'hair as one mass' - those live in the grammar, once, so a new body cannot be added without them. Poses are chosen for the PRINTER first: arms in, no held thin objects, feet together or shoulder-width on a plinth. A pose that reads well on screen and snaps at 110mm is not a pose this library keeps.

bodies.name: Business suit
bodies.subject: a man in his forties
bodies.costume: a charcoal two-piece business suit, white shirt, navy tie, polished shoes
bodies.pose: standing squarely, hands at his sides, shoulders back
